alternatives_rejected.why: Own span self-time is unchanged (0.2->0.2ms). The slowdown appears only on inbound calls from checkoutservice, which is slow to every callee (E2).
Its latency rise matches checkoutservice's uniform outbound slowdown across all six callees, so it reflects the caller-side network delay (E3).
It is one of the six callees that slowed together from checkoutservice's side, so it is a downstream symptom rather than an independent fault (E3).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the checkoutservice pod's network path (for example, tc/netem qdisc rules, sidecar or CNI latency) and remove the injected or anomalous delay. Then verify that checkoutservice p50/p90 latency and inbound latency to emailservice and shippingservice return to baseline. Escalate to a pod restart only if the delay cannot be cleared in place.
